propositions: The completion-verify agent step has no loop breaker: tool_step_limit is never set on the primary verify step, allowing runaway tool-call cycles to burn the entire step budget and die without a verdict.

When the agent falls into a repeating tool-call cycle, it exhausts the step budget (240 requests / 480 tool calls) on redundant calls and is killed with no verdict, leaving --force-close as the only documented exit.

The existing loop detector max_consecutive_repeat is blind to k-cycles where k>=2; it measures only adjacent identical calls and scores pathological runs below healthy runs, making it unsuitable as an actuator trigger.

A windowed distinct-ratio discriminator (trailing 24 tool calls, trip <= 0.50) successfully separates repetitive runs from genuine breadth work and fires reliably on all three real pathological runs while never firing on healthy runs.
The runaway loop must route into the shipped bounded recovery + tool-free finalizer with per-criterion evidence, not land a verdict on the poisoned history where the agent looped.
